user.title: Household State
user.description: Resolves the household stage, directive and integrity axes from the existing threat sources, plus the QUIET modifier from sleep mode and any custom macro states you define. It reads only: it writes nothing, calls no service, and changes no other entity.

error.invalid_name: That name cannot be turned into an entity id. Use at least one letter or digit.
error.reserved_name: Household State already publishes an entity with that name. Choose another.
error.duplicate_name: A macro state with that name already exists.
error.entity_required: A macro state has to name the entity it reads.
error.not_confirmed: Tick the confirmation to delete this macro state.

init.title: Household State options
init.description: Sources and the poll interval, or the custom macro states this household publishes.

bindings.title: Sources
bindings.description: Which entity supplies each source. Leaving one blank keeps the shipped default; an id that does not resolve reports as absent rather than as a quiet zero.

macro_add.title: Define a macro state
macro_add.description: A macro state is a named household modifier — Guest, Vacation, Away — resolved from an entity you already have and published as a binary sensor beside the axes. It is read-only: it mirrors the entity you name, it does not become a switch, and it moves no axis. The name sets the entity id and cannot be changed afterwards; everything else can.

data_description.name: Becomes the entity id — the name, lowercased, with each run of anything else turned into an underscore. Fixed at creation. Up to {max} characters.
data_description.entity_id: Any entity: an input_boolean helper, a schedule, a person, a select.
data_description.on_state: Matched exactly and case-sensitively against the entity's state. "on" for a helper or a schedule; "not_home" for a person; whatever option you chose for a select.
data_description.icon: An mdi: icon, for example mdi:account-group.

macro_detail.title: Edit {name}
macro_detail.description: Editing the macro state published as binary_sensor.household_state_{slug}. Renaming it changes the friendly name only — the entity id stays where it is, so nothing reading it breaks.

data_description.name: The friendly name. The entity id does not follow it.
data_description.entity_id: Any entity: an input_boolean helper, a schedule, a person, a select.
data_description.on_state: Matched exactly and case-sensitively against the entity's state.
data_description.icon: An mdi: icon, for example mdi:account-group.

macro_remove.title: Delete a macro state
macro_remove.description: The entity is removed from the registry, not left behind as an unavailable row — so anything still reading this macro state stops resolving. Its id is freed, so re-adding the same macro later gets the same id back.
